article.headline: Brandon Weston scores 20 to lead Tennessee State over Eastern Illinois 84-65
article.description: — Brandon Weston scored 20 points as Tennessee State beat Eastern Illinois 84-65 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Brandon Weston scores 20 to lead Tennessee State over Eastern Illinois 84-65
article.story: NASHVILLE, Tenn. -- — Brandon Weston scored 20 points as Tennessee State beat Eastern Illinois 84-65 on Saturday night. Weston shot 3 for 5 (2 for 3 from 3-point range) and 12 of 13 from the free-throw line for the Tigers (7-12, 3-5 Ohio Valley Conference). Carlous Williams scored 15 and Antoine Lorick III added 11 points and eight rebounds. Zion Fruster led the Panthers (5-13, 1-6) with 18 points. Kooper Jacobi added 14 points, 13 rebounds and two steals. Artese Stapleton had 14 points and three steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
